correctness.rationale: Independent graph construction from nine explicit 3-point line triples produces 18 vertices, 27 edges, degree three and diameter four. Exhaustively evaluated all choose(18,6)=18564 six-subsets for closed domination and selected-pair distance<=2: 297 satisfy, precisely 9 are total dominating. The lower bound 2n/(2Delta+1) gives gamma_t2>=6, while explicit 6-sets attain it. Constructed all token-jump and slide edges: exactly 1026 and 432; independently computed components nine isolated vertices plus one 288-state component, jump radius/diameter 6/6, slide 8/10, slide eccentricities 126 at 8, 54 at 9, 108 at 10. Independent NetworkX automorphism enumeration gives order 216. This is complete finite exhaustive proof, not an extrapolation.
